text: Implemented shared typed result artifacts: ResultMapName, ContrastId, StatMap, ParameterMap, ContrastMap, ResultManifest, AnalysisProvenance, and ResultExportIntent. Added FitImageMaps adapters for typed parameter/contrast maps plus tests proving metadata/provenance/export-intent preservation and legacy image-map placement compatibility. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test passed 101; sbt fitJS/test passed 98; scoped tracked git diff --check clean; new ResultArtifacts files have no trailing whitespace. Remaining: actual JVM writer adapters for NIfTI/HDF5/GDS/BIDS-style output.
